traits.culm_length_m.note: Hitchcock (1935), as Danthonia californica: culms 30 cm to 80 cm tall.

appearance.organs.panicle.note: The raceme's layout, the model's choice after FNA (volume 25), as search results quote it (the page was not read): a few large spikelets on flexible branches, widely spreading. Each spikelet's glumes drawn 1.15 times the height its florets reach, since FNA's genus account has them usually longer than the florets (a flora's spikelet length runs to the glumes' tips, so the rule from the traits would set them level). Colours by eye: straw.

traits.note: FNA's account of the species (Darbyshire, volume 25), as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): inflorescences usually racemose, with (2)3 to 6(10) widely spreading spikelets; spikelets (10)14 to 26(30) mm; lemma bodies 5 to 10 mm, their two teeth (2)4 to 6(7) mm and bristle-tipped; awns (7)8 to 12 mm. The genus account: glumes usually longer than the florets; the awn rises between the lemma's teeth, bent at a knee (geniculate) and twisted below it.

traits.florets_per_spikelet.note: The Jepson eFlora's account of the species, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): generally 3 to 6 spikelets, generally 14 to 25 mm, their glumes 10 to 23 mm, florets 3 to 8.

traits.upper_glume_length_m.note: The Jepson eFlora's account of the species, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): glumes 10 to 23 mm.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tufted bunchgrass with flat, hairy blades and a few large, plump spikelets on each culm. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 0.6 m tall at 4 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: green blades; pale straw spikelets.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Hitchcock (p. 305, no. 6): blades mostly 10 to 20 cm long, flat, those of the innovations involute.

traits.lower_glume_length_m.note: Hitchcock (p. 305, no. 6): glumes 15 to 20 mm long, rarely shorter or longer; the genus has the glumes about equal.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 1 (Danthonia no. 5, fig. 394): flowers June-July, on dry hills from British Columbia to San Luis Obispo.
